experiment: 4: the attribution-graph gap, split into brackets with floors
status: sealed before job D; single seed
libraries: nnsight 0.8.2 (frozen-pattern, frozen-norm-scale gradient; module-output interventions only, no .source); mwhanna lowl0 transcoders L20..L24 (Base-fit) as nodes. circuit-tracer 0.5.0 is installed --no-deps but its attribution under transformers 5.x is unverified; per the memo's allowed path the edge is the nnsight frozen gradient (circuit-tracer not used)
panel: 32 base items: the first 8 by id of each 1a family (currency, person, landmark, city), consumer M[answer, donor answer]

predictions.G1: the re-routing bracket (arm0 - arm1) has median magnitude <= 0.1 of |arm0| over node-items
predictions.G2: the nonlinearity bracket (arm2 - (-A)) is the largest of the three on >= 0.6 of node-items, and median (arm2 - (-A)) / (arm0 - (-A)) >= 0.5
predictions.G3: the norm-scale bracket (arm1 - arm2) is below the floor on >= 0.7 of node-items
predictions.G4: Spearman between -A and arm0 over node-items >= 0.85
predictions.nulls: the four arms for a matched-norm random active feature at node 1's layer (all brackets within floor on >= 0.75); the machinery null (p and scales frozen, no feature edit) reproduces the base margin within 2 spacings on every item, else the job's arms are not clean
predictions.falsifier: G1 fails with re-routing >= 0.3 of |arm0| on the median node

operational_definitions.nodes: per item the 5 active transcoder features at L20..L24 (answer row) with the largest direct effect rho_F c . a_s d_s on M (float64); node write w = a_s d_s; removal = m += -w
operational_definitions.edge A: g . w with g = dM/dm_l (nnsight, one forward + backward per (item, layer)) under: q_proj and k_proj outputs detached at every later layer (the answer row's p depends on the edit only through its own q and k, so this freezes p exactly), input_layernorm / post_attention_layernorm / final norm outputs replaced by input * gamma * rho_base (rho_base from a clean nnsight pass, detached); MLPs live. The edge forecast -A is sealed as a supplied-forecast record before the arms
operational_definitions.arm0: native, m += -w at the answer row
operational_definitions.arm1: arm0 + the answer row's p at every later layer set to the base run's p (Run.set at t<last>.L<l'>.p)
operational_definitions.arm2: arm1 + a = gamma_in * (h * rho_base) and n = gamma_post * (r * rho_base) at every later layer (h, r read at the stop, written before the layer continues) + the final rho frozen: M2 = rho_F,base c . h_out,last (c = gamma_F (W_U[a] - W_U[b]))
operational_definitions.floor: 2 bf16 spacings at the larger |logit| of (answer, foil)
